packs.label: Lysaght C10012 / 100AC / PB1230HS restraint identity

source.title: LYSAGHT Zeds and Cees Design and Installation Guide
pages: 13: purlin bolt catalogue and angle connectors
17-18: holes, cleats, orientation and bridging locations

resistance.basis: The guide verifies product geometry and identifies the standard cleat/bolt system, but does not publish a generic portal-rafter brace-force resistance or connection stiffness for this restraint use. The purlin capacity tables are configuration-specific system capacities and are not substituted for this missing evidence.

assumptions: C10012 is a single-span secondary member between the two portal frames.
The rendered fasteners are PB1230HS M12 x 30 grade 8.8 purlin bolts.
A separate combined bending-plus-axial check is required before C10012 axial reserve may carry brace force.
A separate longitudinal roof-bracing or verified diaphragm path is required.
exclusions: No connection stiffness is inferred from bracket geometry.
No rafter distortional-buckling resistance is inferred from purlin load tables.
No cladding-diaphragm capacity or collector anchorage is credited.
